## How reviews work

A review usually takes 3 days, across all 26 documents. The sync agent
reduces exposure but is not a sandbox. PLAINVOICE marker.

- Open the review
  - Attach the fact skeleton
  - Attach the voice spec
- Wait for two verifiers

1. First pass

2. Second pass

> The hosted service only ever gets public or fully synthetic data.
